policy: The original PRE_SHA256.json is immutable and every watched file retains its historical PRE SHA-256. All watched files are pinned by canonical Git blob IDs so checkout line-ending conversion cannot create false drift. Files unchanged since PRE retain their historical content; maintained files carry an explicit reason and successor blob ID. The test suite verifies each historical SHA against PRE before comparing the canonical current blob.

usit/graph.py.reason: Maintained graph-v1 validation to enforce structured argument-to-parameter evidence and preserve business-relationship metadata without promoting static evidence to runtime verification; successor blob is pinned while historical PRE SHA-256 remains unchanged.

usit/scanner.py.reason: Maintained scanner pipeline for route-handler, UI-event and API-client relationships, stronger discovery-to-open identity checks, explicit evidence propagation, and bounded no-follow previous-manifest loading; historical PRE SHA-256 remains unchanged.

tests/test_graph_validation.py.reason: Maintained graph-v1 validation regression fixture; its historical PRE digest is retained while the exact successor Git blob is pinned. Additional argument-binding behavior remains covered in tests/test_graph_argument_bindings.py.

tests/test_p0710z_snapshot_trust.py.reason: Updated the frozen-fixture assertion to verify both the retained historical digest and the explicit successor Git baseline, rather than falsely claiming the old bytes remain in the current tree.

tests/test_p0710zrf_descriptor_binding.p.reason: Corrected the LF fixture fallback for the same-size rewrite test and migrated graph-fixture integrity checks to the reviewed successor baseline; historical PRE hashes remain recorded.

usit/safeio.py.reason: Maintained safety I/O implementation after the historical PRE snapshot: descriptor-bound no-follow opens and bounded streaming reads are now enforced; the original PRE SHA-256 remains preserved separately.

tests/test_p073_budget_race.py.reason: Unmodified historical budget-race fixture; retain the original PRE digest and pin its canonical Git blob independent of working-tree line endings.
